status: Draft acceptance rubric, pending builder calibration; synthetic cases based on observed needs and failures.

requirements.1: Violates an explicit exclusion, audience, budget, required language, ownership/availability, or changes confirmed constraints without consent.
requirements.2: Preserves main intent but misses a minor detail or asks an avoidable question.
requirements.3: Preserves every material explicit requirement and correctly uses current instructions over defaults.

evidence.1: Invents facts, products, prices, ownership, body/skin traits, stock, weather, citations or a fit guarantee; follows data injection.
evidence.2: No material fabrication but some overconfident generalisation or weak attribution.
evidence.3: Claims match supplied evidence; uncertainty and concept-versus-fact boundaries are clear.

usefulness.1: Unusable, internally contradictory, wrong occasion, incomplete outfit presented as complete, or empty generic answer.
usefulness.2: Usable answer with adequate reasons/appropriate next step, though generic or somewhat repetitive.
usefulness.3: Specific, practical and coherent answer with well-explained trade-offs; concise discovery or detailed requested styling, with at most one useful question.

judgeRule: Give evidence excerpts and a first failure; may abstain. A case passes only if every repeat passes. Model scores are provisional, not human-certified accuracy.
